summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust (the Trust) through its operating partnership completed the acquisition of Sila Realty Trust, Inc., a Maryland REIT. Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated April 19, 2026, Sila merged with a wholly owned subsidiary of Blue Owl. Each share of Sila common stock was cancelled and converted into the right to receive $30.38 per share in cash, implying an aggregate consideration of approximately $2.4 billion. As a result, Sila became an indirect subsidiary of Blue Owl's operating partnership. This is a cash acquisition with no stock component. The premium is not stated but the price per share was fixed. The transaction closed on July 1, 2026, with no regulatory or shareholder vote conditions discussed. Watch for integration risks and potential earn-out or adjustment clauses.
